name: I-eczema
tagline: Isikhumba esilumayo, esomile. I-Moisturise. Phatha izibangeli.

what_is_it.heading: I-eczema ngemibandela ecacile
what_is_it.lede: I-eczema (ebizwa nangokuthi i-atopic dermatitis) yisimo sesikhumba sesikhathi eside lapho umgoqo wesikhumba ungawubambi kahle umswakama futhi ucasuka kalula. Umphumela: omile, uyaluma, amabala avuthayo - kwesinye isikhathi avutha kabi, kwesinye isikhathi azolile.
paragraphs: I-eczema ivame ukuqala ebuntwaneni - cishe ingane eyodwa kwezi-5 zaseNingizimu Afrika iba nayo. Abaningi bayathuthuka ngokukhula, nakuba ingabuya noma nini. I-eczema eqala kubantu abadala nayo ivamile. Ivamise ukuhambisana nesifuba somoya, i-hay fever, noma ukungezwani nokudla okuthile - 'i-atopic triad'.

I-eczema ayitheleleki. Akubangwa ukungcola noma ukungahlanzeki. Isithiyo sesikhumba ku-eczema sihlukile nje ngokofuzo - sinezimbotshana eziningi, sisebenza kakhulu. Izindaba ezinhle: ngokuswakama kwansuku zonke kanye nokuphathwa kwe-trigger, abantu abaningi bayigcina ilawulwa kahle.

items.headline: 1 ku5
items.body: Izingane zaseNingizimu Afrika zine-eczema. Abaningi bayathuthuka ngokukhula. I-eczema yabantu abadala ivamile futhi.

items.headline: I-Moisturizer iyawina
items.body: Ukuswakama kwansuku zonke - ngisho noma isikhumba sibukeka sisihle - ukwelashwa kwe-eczema okukodwa okunamandla kakhulu. Yeqa izinsuku ezimbalwa bese umlilo uyabuya.

items.headline: Ayithelelani
items.body: Awukwazi ukubamba i-eczema. Ayibangelwa ukungcola noma inhlanzeko. Kuyinkinga yokuvimbela isikhumba sofuzo, ngokuvamile ehambisana nengxenye yokungezwani komzimba.

items.headline: Ama-steroid creams ayasebenza
items.body: Ama-topical steroids ngesikhathi sokuvutha aphephile uma esetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Bathulisa ukuvuvukala ukuze isikhumba siphole.

pull_quote.text: Iningi le-eczema lilawulwa kahle ngezinyathelo ezimbili ezilula: moisturise kabili ngosuku nsuku zonke, futhi usebenzise ukhilimu we-steroid lapho uvutha. Iphutha abantu abaningi elenzayo ukumisa okokuthambisa uma isikhumba sibukeka sisihle.

signs.heading: Ibukeka kanjani i-eczema
signs.lede: I-eczema ibonakala ezindaweni ezijwayelekile futhi inamaphethini ajwayelekile. Ukubukeka kungahluka kumathoni esikhumba ahlukene - esikhumbeni esimnyama singabonakala simpunga, sinsomi, noma sibe nsundu ngokumnyama kunencwadi ebomvu.

items.title: Izingane kanye nezingane ezincane
items.description: Izihlathi, isikhumba sekhanda, nezingalo nemilenze yangaphandle. Okubomvu (noma okumnyama, esikhumbeni esiMnyama), omile, amabalashana avame ukuba wuqweqwe. Kuyaluma kakhulu - izingane zinwaya ngisho zilele.

items.title: Izingane ezindala kanye nabantu abadala
items.description: Ukugoqa kwesikhumba — ngaphakathi kwezindololwane, ngemuva kwamadolo, izihlakala, intamo, amaqakala. Iziqephu zesikhumba esijiyile, esinamaxolo, esilumayo. Izandla namajwabu ajwayelekile kubantu abadala.

items.title: Isikhathi sokukhathazeka - ukutheleleka
items.description: Uma amabalazwe ekhala, aphuzi, abe buhlungu kakhulu, noma asakazeke ngokushesha - angase atheleleke. Idinga ukuhlolwa komtholampilo ukuze uthole ama-antibiotics noma ukwelashwa kwe-antiviral.

items.fact: Esetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ezifundweni ezimfushane ngesikhathi sokuvutha, ama-topical steroids aphephile futhi ayasebenza. Ukuzigwema kubangela ukulimala okwengeziwe - i-eczema engalawuleki engapheli ishubisa isikhumba futhi ibangele izifo.

I-allergies yangempela yokudla ibangela i-eczema kwezinye izingane - kodwa i-eczema eningi ayiqhutshwa ukudla. Gwema ukuqeda ukudla ngaphandle kweseluleko sezokwelapha; zingadala umonakalo wangempela wokudla okunomsoco.

Ukunwaya kulimaza kakhulu umgoqo wesikhumba, kukhiphe amakhemikhali engeziwe wokulunywa, futhi kudala umjikelezo ononya wokulunywa. Ukuminyanisa okubandayo, okokuthambisa, nama-antihistamine kuyasiza - ukunwaya akusizi.

Abaningi bayakwenza, kodwa abaningi abakwenzi. Ngisho nalabo 'abakhula' bangaba namaqhubu lapho sebekhulile. Imikhuba yokunakekela isikhumba impilo yonke - izihlanzi ezithambile, okokuthambisa nsuku zonke - kufanelekile ukwakha kusenesikhathi.

prevention.heading: Imikhuba yansuku zonke egcina ivutha
prevention.lede: Ukuphathwa kwe-eczema kumayelana nokunakekelwa kwesikhumba nsuku zonke - imikhuba emincane evimbela ukuqubuka okulandelayo.

items.title: Moisturise kabili ngosuku, nsuku zonke
items.description: Isimanzi esijiyile esinganamakha phakathi kwemizuzu emi-3 yokugeza izivaluli emanzini. Qhubeka noma ngabe isikhumba sibukeka sisihle - yilokhu okuvimbela ukuqubuka okulandelayo.

items.title: Amabhavu amafushane afudumele noma amashawa
items.description: Amanzi ashisayo ahlubula isikhumba. Sebenzisa amanzi ayisivivi, ukugeza okunganamakha (hhayi insipho evamile), imizuzu engu-5-10 ubukhulu. Komisa kancane — ungahlikihli.

items.title: Yazi futhi ugweme izibangeli zakho
items.description: Izimbangela ezivamile: ukushisa nokujuluka, uboya kanye nezindwangu zokwenziwa, izinsipho ezinokhahlo kanye nezinto zokuhlanza, ukucindezeleka, izifo (izilwane ezifuywayo, uthuli). Gcina idayari ye-flare ukuze ubone eyakho.

items.title: Igumbi lokulala elipholile, elipholile
items.description: Ukushisa nomjuluko kuba kubi kakhulu ukulunywa ebusuku. Gcina ikamelo lokulala lipholile, sebenzisa amashidi kakotini, futhi ungafaki izingane ngokweqile. Isipholile sizolile.

items.title: Faka ukhilimu we-steroid kuma-flare asebenzayo
items.description: Itholakala emitholampilo - ngokuvamile i-hydrocortisone (emnene) ebusweni nasezinsaneni, inamandla emzimbeni. Sebenzisa kancane emapheshana abomvu kabili ngosuku kuze kuthuleke. Bese ume.

items.title: Gcina umswakama - ngisho nangaphezu kwe-steroid
items.description: Faka isicelo se-moisturizer imizuzu engama-30 ngemuva kwe-steroid, noma ngezinye izikhathi. I-moisturizer isekela ukuphulukiswa - ungayeki ngoba usebenzisa i-steroid.

items.title: Thatha i-antihistamine uma uluma kakhulu
items.description: I-Cetirizine noma i-loratadine isiza ngokuluma, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Itholakala phezu kwekhawunta kunoma yiliphi ikhemisi. Iwusizo ikakhulukazi ezinganeni ezinwaya ekulaleni kwazo.

items.title: Uma isikhumba sikhala noma sitheleleka - hamba uye emtholampilo
items.description: Uqweqwe oluphuzi, ukusabalala okubuhlungu, umkhuhlane - kungase kube ukutheleleka kwebhaktheriya (i-staph) noma i-eczema herpeticum (igciwane, elibi kakhulu). Idinga ukwelashwa ngokushesha.

items.title: Nge-eczema enzima noma okunzima ukuyilawula
items.description: Imitholampilo kahulumeni ingadlulisela kudokotela wesikhumba. Ukwelashwa okusha okufana ne-dupilumab (umjovo we-biologic) kuguqule i-eczema enzima eminyakeni yamuva.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Iningi le-eczema lilawulwa kahle ezingeni lasemtholampilo. Izimo ezinzima ziyazuza ekudlulisweni kwe-dermatology - kutholakala ngohlelo lomphakathi.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala kwe-eczema, ama-moisturisers, nama-steroid creams
